zh.note: 以企業對企業（B2B）為主，只有開放民眾的那天可以零售，而且要開發票。

en.name: FOOD TAIPEI 2027
en.fee: 2023 ref: raw space from US$1,550 per 9 m²
en.timing: Usually opens in late November of the prior year
en.note: Mainly B2B; retail only on the public day, with invoices.

ORGS.wzh: 手作市集；國父紀念館、中正紀念堂、高雄美術館。春季、秋季和 12 月聖誕場，招募公告在 IG／Threads。
ORGS.wen: Handmade markets at Sun Yat-sen and CKS Memorial Halls and the Kaohsiung Museum of Fine Arts. Spring, autumn and December Christmas editions; calls posted on IG/Threads.

ORGS.wzh: 台中小農＋設計市集，在臺中州廳、夏綠地公園等地輪流舉辦；每場的報名表放在活動頁。
ORGS.wen: Taichung farmers and design market, rotating between the Prefectural Hall, Charlotte Park and more. Each event page carries its own form.

ORGS.wzh: 設計品牌展會：6 月品品節（松菸）、10–11 月 Design Fest（圓山）。
ORGS.wen: Design-brand fairs: PinPin Fest in June (Songshan), Design Fest in Oct–Nov (Expo Dome).

ORGS.wzh: 全台場次最多的主辦之一：松菸、駁二常態場，也承辦音樂祭市集（臺北爵士音樂節、浪人祭）。
ORGS.wen: One of Taiwan's busiest organizers: regular Songshan and Pier-2 markets, plus festival markets (Taipei Jazz Festival, Vagabond Fest).

ORGS.wzh: 台北幾乎每月都有：心中山、捷運站、美麗華、華山。
ORGS.wen: Nearly monthly in Taipei: Zhongshan linear park, MRT stations, Miramar, Huashan.

ORGS.wzh: 台北松菸、高雄駁二的週末場；要先註冊品牌會員才看得到場次。注意：禁止用 AI 生成的商品圖、菜單、文宣，報名照片也算。
ORGS.wen: Weekend markets at Songshan (Taipei) and Pier-2 (Kaohsiung). Register as a brand member to see events. Note: AI-generated product photos, menus and signage are banned, including in your application photos.

ORGS.wzh: 台中：文心森林公園、民俗公園等，有主題夜市和聖誕場。
ORGS.wen: Taichung: Wenxin Forest Park, Folk Park and more; themed night and Christmas editions.

ORGS.wzh: 松菸、華山、花博的審核制市集，用自家報名系統。下一個大場是 2027 年 4 月松菸「戀舊同樂會」。
ORGS.wen: Juried markets at Songshan, Huashan and Expo Park, via its own sign-up system. Next big one: April 2027 at Songshan.

ORGS.wzh: 高雄、台南；駁二、高雄流行音樂中心的演唱會場。每場表單放在 Linktree。
ORGS.wen: Kaohsiung and Tainan, including Pier-2 and concert markets at the Kaohsiung Music Center. Forms on its Linktree.

ORGS.wzh: 每年 10 月在臺北流行音樂中心；市集由邊緣工事招募。2026 年已結束。
ORGS.wen: Every October at Taipei Music Center; the market is recruited by Edge Works. 2026 is over.

ORGS.wzh: 每年 10 月在中壢；2026 年已結束。
ORGS.wen: Every October in Zhongli; 2026 is over.

ORGS.wzh: 夢時代時代大道；啤酒節在 7 月。目前沒看到攤商招募。
ORGS.wen: Dream Mall; the beer fest is in July. No vendor call found yet.

ORGS.wzh: 台南；12 月聖誕週末有上百攤市集（2025 年暫停，2026 年尚未公告）。
ORGS.wen: Tainan; a 100+ booth Christmas Weekend market in December (paused in 2025; 2026 not announced).

ORGS.wzh: 大型音樂與生活風格節，品牌市集另外招募。2026 年尚未公告。
ORGS.wen: Large music and lifestyle festival with a separately recruited brand market. 2026 not announced yet.

ORGS.wzh: 新竹市政府主辦，9–11 月週末在護城河舉辦，免攤位費。每年 7–8 月招募，限新竹市登記或營業的品牌，或過去一年在新竹市市集出攤 3 次以上。
ORGS.wen: Run by Hsinchu City Government; weekends Sep–Nov along the city moat, free booths. Call in Jul–Aug, for Hsinchu-registered brands or those with 3+ Hsinchu market appearances in the past year.

ORGS.wzh: 新北市經發局主辦，10 月初招募、11 月底在市民廣場舉辦，限新北市登記的業者。2026 年已截止。
ORGS.wen: New Taipei Economic Development Dept; call in early October, market late November at Citizen Plaza, New Taipei-registered businesses only. 2026 call closed.

ORGS.zh: 士林官邸鬱金香展市集
ORGS.wzh: 臺北市公園處；2026 年的招募到 1/2 截止，市集在 2–3 月。2027 年的招募預計 12 月左右公告。
ORGS.wen: Taipei Parks Office; the 2026 call closed Jan 2 for a Feb–Mar market. Expect the 2027 call around December.

ORGS.wzh: 臺中市觀旅局；上一次招募是 11 月中到 12 月初，2027 年的預計 11 月中公告。
ORGS.wen: Taichung Tourism Bureau; the last call ran mid-Nov to early Dec, so expect the 2027 call around mid-November.

ORGS.wzh: 2027/2/20–3/7 在苗栗後龍高鐵特區，攤商招募還沒公告。參考：2025 年主辦城市 12 月開放招募，在地業者優先。
ORGS.wen: Feb 20–Mar 7, 2027 at the Miaoli HSR area; no vendor call yet. For reference, the 2025 host city opened its call in December with priority for local vendors.

ORGS.wzh: 臺北市客委會；8 月招募、10 月舉辦，以客家品牌為主。
ORGS.wen: Taipei Hakka Affairs Commission; call in August, market in October, for Hakka brands.

ORGS.wzh: TAKAO 豐潮、Miaca' 市集；限設籍高雄、18 歲以上的原住民，不收攤位費。春、秋兩季招募。
ORGS.wen: TAKAO and Miaca' markets for indigenous vendors 18+ registered in Kaohsiung; no booth rent. Calls in spring and autumn.

ORGS.zh: 高美館 小世界市集
ORGS.wzh: 高雄市立美術館；沒有公開表單，要打電話報名：(07)555-0331 分機 267。
ORGS.wen: Kaohsiung Museum of Fine Arts; no public form. Apply by phone: (07)555-0331 ext. 267.

ORGS.en: Pier-2 Lunar New Year Night Market
ORGS.wzh: 高雄駁二的過年市集，2026 年有 250 多個品牌。2027 年的招募還沒公告。
ORGS.wen: Pier-2's Lunar New Year market, 250+ brands in 2026. The 2027 call isn't posted yet.

ORGS.wzh: 活動市集大約在一個月前招募，保證金 1,000 元。
ORGS.wen: Festival markets recruit about a month ahead; NT$1,000 deposit.

ORGS.wzh: 台北花博公園，只收農友。
ORGS.wen: Taipei Expo Park; farmers only.

ORGS.wzh: 只收農友與生產者，會先到產地拜訪，希望長期參與。
ORGS.wen: Farmers and producers only. They visit your farm first and expect long-term participation.
